examples.en: "Man does not strive for happiness; only the Englishman does that," wrote Nietzsche in The Twilight of the Idols.
examples.zh: 尼采在《偶像的黄昏》中写到：“人类不力求幸福；只有英国人才那么做。”

examples.en: That is why Nietzsche called the idea of eternal return the heaviest of burdens (das schwerste Gewicht).
examples.zh: 这就是为什么尼采说永恒回归是最沉重的负担吧。

examples.en: For Nietzsche, genuine love cannot evoke guilt.
examples.zh: 对尼采来说，真爱是不能引发任何负罪感的。
